key_highlights: ASX slid to three-month low as banks and miners fell; oil prices jumped on China Yuan crude futures hitting record highs
Fed rate hike under Warsh spooked global investors; Wall Street fell, pressuring ASX sentiment
Chinese growth 'sinks from sight' raising demand concerns for Australian commodity exporters
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm across construction and property sectors
Diesel supply crunch at east-coast ports disrupts fuel distribution; energy logistics under stress
Mining positives: record gold grades at Aguia (Colombia), Auric fast-tracks WA Burbanks plant, Barkly rare earths discovery in NT
Migration overhaul targeting temporary visas creates uncertainty for universities and labour-dependent sectors
Anthropic $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland signals AI infrastructure buildout
Cue and Veronika Maine up for sale after 58 years; consumer discretionary under pressure
Mortgage stress and negative equity increasingly pressure young Australian borrowers

sectors.trend: Mixed: miners fell on ASX amid Chinese growth concerns and oil volatility, but gold and rare earths discoveries provide offsetting positives. Coal demand debate ongoing.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from weak Chinese demand. Gold miners (A2M.AX, NGN.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, BRL.AX) offer relative strength. Coal (BLL.AX, WDS.AX) may see renewed interest.

sectors.trend: Banks led ASX declines. Credit growth outpacing China's, mortgage stress rising, private credit concerns, and Bathla insolvency storm pressure NPL expectations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate environment and rising credit risk. Superannuation reform debate (SGP.AX, HUB.AX) adds policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Oil prices jumped on record China Yuan crude futures; diesel supply crunch at east-coast ports. Green hydrogen policy under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BOQ.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil strength. Fuel distribution logistics disrupted. Green hydrogen policy risk weighs on renewable energy names.

sectors.trend: Cue and Veronika Maine collapse signals structural weakness in discretionary fashion. Bathla insolvency hits construction-linked consumer. Pay growth lagging inflation.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail arms) face soft demand. Construction (GRO.AX, MCA.AX) exposed to Bathla contagion. Consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) relatively defensive.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn datacentre in Queensland signals major AI capex. Data centre power demand growing. Tokenised stocks and crypto regulation evolving.
sectors.implications: Power generators (AGL.AX, GPT.AX, ORG.AX) benefit from data centre demand. Tech infrastructure names gain. Crypto volatility (CoinEx shutdown) a tail risk.

sectors.trend: Bathla insolvency storm and mortgage stress create overhang. Young Australians facing negative equity. Housing affordability remains acute.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction REITs exposed to insolvency contagion.

key_themes: Fed rate hike under Warsh creating global risk-off; AUD/USD likely under pressure
Chinese growth deceleration threatening iron ore, coal, and LNG demand
Commodity price volatility: oil at record China futures, gold grades positive
Credit and insolvency contagion: Bathla, private credit, mortgage stress
Migration policy overhaul creating labour supply uncertainty
AI/data centre infrastructure as structural growth theme
Consumer discretionary weakness: fashion, retail under structural pressure
Energy logistics disruption: diesel supply crunch at east-coast ports

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike / Warsh hawkishness spilling into global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; increase allocation to domestic-yield assets; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese growth deceleration hitting commodity demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce overweight to iron ore/coal; diversify into gold and rare earths

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bathla insolvency contagion across construction and property
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid construction-linked equities; monitor NPL data for banks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Diesel/fuel supply crunch disrupting logistics and transport
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor energy names; assess transport sector (WBC.AX logistics) exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Migration overhaul creating labour supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour automation/tech beneficiaries; cautious on labour-intensive sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US debt / crypto volatility (CoinEx shutdown, Trump crypto)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit crypto-adjacent exposure; monitor systemic risk indicators

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths miners amid Chinese demand uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Record gold grades (Aguia), Auric WA plant acceleration, and Barkly rare earths discovery provide fundamental support while broad mining faces headwinds

opportunities.recommendation: Add to power generators and energy infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn datacentre and broader AI capex cycle drive structural power demand; oil strength supports upstream names
Coal demand 'demise greatly exaggerated' narrative; energy transition slower than priced; China still reliant on thermal coal

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to banks and construction-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla insolvency storm, rising mortgage stress, and credit growth concerns pressure NPLs and margins

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer discretionary; rotate to staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Cue/Veronika Maine collapse, pay growth lagging inflation, and weak consumer confidence signal structural softness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce iron ore/coal overweight
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike, Chinese growth deceleration, and oil volatility create headwinds for AUD and commodity exporters

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. Fed hawkishness, Chinese growth concerns, and oil volatility cap upside. Three-month low already breached. RBA likely on hold but AUD weakens. Watch for insolvency contagion from Bathla. Oil strength provides partial support for energy names.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Chinese stimulus materialises and global rates stabilise. Structural themes: AI/data centre capex, energy transition, rare earths supply chain. Consumer and property sectors face multi-quarter headwinds from affordability and insolvency. Superannuation reform may create policy tailwinds for fund managers.
